title: Distributed Phase Tags: A Locality-Preserving Realification Compiler for Misty-State Quantum Programs
summary: Complex amplitudes can be simulated over real Hilbert spaces by adjoining a two-dimensional real/imaginary degree of freedom. In a multipartite program, however, one globally shared phase tag is not a locality-preserving program transformation: every party would have to act on the same auxiliary system. We recast the distributed real simulation of multipartite quantum mechanics as a syntax-directed compiler into a real misty-state intermediate language.
